TextBlock.Text: ARAFURA SEA. The ceasefire came into effect at midnight and traffic started moving at first light because insurers move faster than diplomats. CORAL PIONEER is at the head of the first convoy through, with a bearing running hot and nine knots she can hold. There are two groups in the box. One has acknowledged its withdrawal order and is heading north at steady speed. The other has not acknowledged anything since 0400 and has a maritime strike flight within range. Tell them apart. Get the convoy home. Do not be the incident that restarts this - a withdrawing ship you sink today is the reason there is no ceasefire on Monday.

Coral Pioneer, nine knots, one shaft. One group out there is complying with the ceasefire and one is deciding whether to. Tell them apart before you fire, because the ceasefire is the campaign, and a mistake tonight reopens all of it.
Convoy: Bring the convoy, Coral Pioneer at its head, into Darwin's approaches Ceasefire: Do not sink a withdrawing ship Escorts: Bring the escorts home
Your escort group with HMAS Eyre and her flight attached, a Poseidon, and four merchant hulls. Two opposing groups: one withdrawing, one not. A Wedgetail is up.
65 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.
Destroying a neutral contact ends the operation in failure. Identify before you shoot.

S-70B-2 Seahawk with AGM-114 'Hellfire' Missiles, Boeing P-8 Poseidon, E-7A Wedgetail, Merchants Expanded, Auxiliary Merchant Pack, RE-power: the resupply mod, Chinese Navy (PLAN), PLAN Type 071 Amphibious Transport Dock, Modern PLAN Systems, XIAN JH-7A (歼轰-7A 飞豹), MH-60R Seahawk, RAAF F-35A Lightning II, this pack.
